feature_kinds.continuous_firm: Winsorize and centered-rank within the signal-date long-eligible scoring cross-section; then fill missing with zero and add a dedicated missingness indicator.
feature_kinds.binary_firm: Retain 0/1. Nullable binary values use value=0 plus a dedicated missingness indicator; genuine zero uses value=0 and missingness=0.
feature_kinds.categorical_firm: One-hot encode every frozen category without dropping a reference level and include an explicit UNKNOWN category.
feature_kinds.categorical_multihot_firm: Expand the frozen 8-K item-family vocabulary to binary presence columns. Multiple item families may be active; UNKNOWN means missing SEC coverage and NO_EVENT means positive coverage with no event in the window.
feature_kinds.aggregate_state: Use an expanding past-only z-score based on signal months strictly before the current signal, sample standard deviation, at least two prior nonmissing values and positive standard deviation; clip to [-5,5], then fill missing with zero and add a dedicated missingness indicator.

global_formula_rules.session_clock: Verified global CRSP trading sessions; window endpoints are inclusive and offsets are relative to the signal close with offset 0 equal to signal_date.
global_formula_rules.unspecified_minimum: Every input required by a formula must be valid. A feature is missing when its complete required input set is unavailable; partial-window scaling is prohibited.
global_formula_rules.return_window: Use each verified authoritative CRSP return leg exactly once. The union of (return_span_start_date,return_span_end_date] must exactly cover the requested sessions without overlap or gap. Compound as product(1+r_leg)-1.
global_formula_rules.adjusted_price_return_path: For an N-session path, normalize the oldest level to 1 and recursively multiply by 1+raw_return_ex_distributions (CRSP DlyRetx) for each of the remaining N-1 sessions. Every transition must be a distinct observed ordinary one-session price return available by the signal close; every literal close in the N-session window remains a positive completeness gate. This preserves price appreciation while removing mechanical split discontinuities and excluding ordinary-dividend reinvestment.
global_formula_rules.one_session_statistics: Daily distribution statistics use only return_history_usable=true, covered_trading_sessions=1 observations with all aligned factors present where applicable.
global_formula_rules.point_in_time: Every contributing observation must satisfy observation_date<=signal_date and public_availability_date<=signal_date. If stale_after_date exists, signal_date<=stale_after_date is also required. No future backfill.
global_formula_rules.lineage: For every raw feature, retain maximum contributing observation_date and maximum contributing public_availability_date in a separate lineage table.
global_formula_rules.numeric_domain: Any nonfinite result, zero forbidden denominator, nonpositive logarithm input or violated formula precondition yields missing, never an arbitrary cap or zero.
global_formula_rules.compustat_scale: Compustat monetary statement items are converted from reported millions to nominal reported-currency units by multiplying by 1000000 before ratios to USD market value; the multiplier cancels in accounting-to-accounting ratios.
global_formula_rules.fundamental_bundle: Prefer a bundle of four consecutive timely fiscal quarters ending at the latest eligible quarter. Discrete quarterly flows are summed; YTD flows are first differenced within fiscal year (Q1 equals its YTD value). Use the latest eligible annual bundle only when four consecutive timely quarters do not exist. Do not switch source basis feature by feature.
global_formula_rules.fundamental_currency: Accounting-to-market-value formulas require reporting currency USD because no verified point-in-time FX source exists. Otherwise those values are missing and accounting_market_currency_verified records 0. Accounting-to-accounting formulas may use any single consistent reported currency.
global_formula_rules.trailing_calendar_window: An N-calendar-day event window is (signal_date-N calendar days, signal_date].
global_formula_rules.category_vocabulary: Fixed enumerations are used where supplied. Otherwise the Phase 3 development build freezes UNKNOWN first followed by distinct normalized development values in UTF-8 byte order; validation/final unseen values map to UNKNOWN and may never add columns.
global_formula_rules.optionmetrics_zero: An unmatched, NOT_COVERED or ambiguous OptionMetrics link makes the entire family missing. Zero is valid only for a MATCHED security with the dated vendor CALL and PUT rows proving genuine zero.

formula_catalog.compounded_total_return: Compound authoritative return legs over the exact session window.
formula_catalog.price_to_moving_average: latest normalized adjusted-price-return-path level divided by the arithmetic mean of all positive path levels in the window, minus 1.
formula_catalog.distance_to_high: latest normalized adjusted-price-return-path level divided by the maximum path level in the window, minus 1.
formula_catalog.log_price_trend: OLS of ln(normalized adjusted-price-return-path level) on integer session index 0..N-1 from oldest to newest; return either slope per session or ordinary R-squared.
formula_catalog.maximum_drawdown: Minimum over the exact total-return wealth path of wealth/running_max(wealth)-1, including initial wealth 1.
formula_catalog.realized_volatility: sqrt(252) times sample standard deviation (ddof=1) of one-session decimal total returns.
formula_catalog.downside_semivolatility: sqrt(252*mean(min(return,0)^2)) over one-session decimal total returns.
formula_catalog.beta_label: EWLS of security excess return on intercept plus MKT-RF,SMB,HML,RMW,CMA,UMD over latest 252 sessions, at least 126 valid one-session observations, weight 2^(-age_sessions/126); slopes are clipped by signal month and factor at type-7 1/99 percentiles.
formula_catalog.sample_skewness: Bias-corrected Fisher-Pearson sample skewness of one-session returns.
formula_catalog.sample_excess_kurtosis: Bias-corrected Fisher excess kurtosis of one-session returns.
formula_catalog.window_extreme: Maximum or minimum one-session return in the exact window.
formula_catalog.volatility_change: current realized_volatility_63d divided by the median of the 252 prior signal-session realized_volatility_63d estimates, minus 1; all 252 historical estimates must be valid.
formula_catalog.natural_log: Natural logarithm of the stated strictly positive input.
formula_catalog.window_median: Type-7-independent ordinary median of the complete daily input window (middle value or mean of the two middle values).
formula_catalog.share_turnover: Arithmetic mean of volume_shares/shares_outstanding over the complete window using inclusive date-valid shares intervals.
formula_catalog.amihud: Arithmetic mean of abs(one-session total return)/positive screening_dollar_volume_usd over the complete window.
formula_catalog.spread_hierarchy: Median full spread from valid quotes when at least 10 of 20 sessions qualify; otherwise median of at least 10 valid overnight-adjusted Corwin-Schultz pairs; otherwise contemporaneous exchange 5x5 size/ADV-cell median with the frozen adjacent-ADV, adjacent-size, exchange, full-universe fallback hierarchy in Methodology v1.
formula_catalog.zero_share: Count of exact zero daily inputs divided by the complete session count.
formula_catalog.dollar_volume_shock: median dollar volume over offsets [-19,0] divided by median dollar volume over offsets [-271,-20], minus 1.
formula_catalog.calendar_month_age: Maximum of zero and completed calendar months from the first historically observed CRSP session at or before the signal that satisfies the frozen regular-way tradability fields; SecurityBegDt and other future lifecycle metadata are prohibited.
formula_catalog.fundamental_ratio: Use the named numerator and denominator from the frozen fundamental bundle and formula parameters; ratio-of-averages rules use arithmetic mean of beginning and ending balance.
formula_catalog.signed_growth: (current-prior_year)/abs(prior_year), requiring nonzero prior_year; sales, asset and share growth additionally require both levels positive.
formula_catalog.fundamental_indicator: Binary condition evaluated only when its stated fundamental input is observed.
formula_catalog.fundamental_source_basis: TTM when a four-consecutive-quarter bundle is used, ANNUAL_FALLBACK when the annual bundle is used, otherwise UNKNOWN.
formula_catalog.institutional_ownership: For each manager/report_date use the latest filing available by signal; an available amendment replaces the earlier filing. Exclude nonblank put_call rows, sum duplicate equity rows by normalized CUSIP8, and aggregate current nonstale manager positions to the date-valid CRSP identity.
formula_catalog.days_since_filing: Calendar days from the latest eligible filing public_availability_date through signal_date.
formula_catalog.filing_form: Form family of the same latest filing; generic 6-K is never classified as an interim financial statement without a separately verified classification.
formula_catalog.event_count: Count distinct source records in the stated trailing calendar window.
formula_catalog.event_recency: Calendar days since the latest event inside the stated trailing window; missing if none.
formula_catalog.latest_8k_item_families: For positively covered SEC links, activate every normalized 8-K item_number observed in the trailing window; activate NO_EVENT when none exists. Missing/ambiguous SEC linkage activates UNKNOWN. The development vocabulary is UNKNOWN, NO_EVENT, then normalized observed 8-K item values in UTF-8 order; 6-K never enters this taxonomy.
formula_catalog.event_indicator: 1 when at least one linked public event exists in the stated trailing calendar window, 0 when the link family is positively covered and none exists, otherwise missing.
formula_catalog.segment_statistic: At the latest eligible segment datadate, count distinct positive-revenue segment IDs by business/geographic type or compute business-segment revenue-share HHI; missing when the family is absent.
formula_catalog.identity_category: Availability-aligned identity/Compustat mapping defined by parameters; future lifecycle fields and current master data are prohibited.
formula_catalog.option_flow_sum: Sum the authoritative CALL or PUT vendor values over every session in the complete window; combined equals CALL+PUT and never adds TOTAL/blank rows.
formula_catalog.option_open_interest: Signal-close CALL or PUT open_interest; combined equals CALL+PUT.
formula_catalog.log_put_call_ratio: ln((put+1)/(call+1)) using 21-session volume or signal-close open interest as stated.
formula_catalog.call_minus_put_share: (call-put)/(call+put); when both are verified genuine zero return 0.
formula_catalog.option_log_change: ln(1+current total)-ln(1+total at the exact signal month lag).
formula_catalog.option_to_underlying_volume: Combined 21-session option volume divided by summed positive underlying CRSP share volume over the same complete sessions.
formula_catalog.option_coverage: 1 only for a MATCHED link with dated authoritative CALL and PUT coverage at signal; family noncoverage remains missing, not 0.
formula_catalog.option_coverage_age: Completed calendar months from first dated authoritative CALL-and-PUT coverage under the date-valid link through signal month.
formula_catalog.option_historical_volatility: Signal-close vendor volatility in decimal annualized units at the exact mapped vendor day code.
formula_catalog.difference: First named feature minus second named feature.
formula_catalog.factor_trailing_sum: Arithmetic sum of the decimal monthly factor over the last N completed factor months ending at signal month.
formula_catalog.latest_monthly_value: Latest decimal monthly value whose observation and public-availability dates satisfy the signal cutoff.
formula_catalog.market_realized_volatility: sqrt(252) times sample standard deviation of daily MKT-RF over the exact complete session window.
formula_catalog.ps_level: Latest historically revised Pástor-Stambaugh level legitimately available by signal; no carry after the series ends.
formula_catalog.ps_recursive_innovation: L_t-(a_{t-1}+rho_{t-1}*L_{t-1}); OLS AR(1) with intercept uses only level pairs ending at t-1 and at least 60 prior observations. Raw full-sample PS_INNOV is prohibited.

members.name: foreign_listing_indicator
members.mapping: 1 for a known non-US domicile resolved by the frozen domicile mapping; 0 for known US domicile; otherwise missing

members.name: adr_indicator
members.mapping: 1 share_type AD; 0 share_type NS; otherwise missing

members.name: us_incorporation_indicator
members.mapping: direct availability-aligned CRSP USIncFlg: Y=>1, N=>0, otherwise missing; retained separately from resolved domicile

members.name: ff12_sector_category
members.mapping: contemporaneous SIC to frozen Fama-French 12 industry map

members.name: domicile_country_category
members.mapping: availability-aligned Compustat fic first, loc only as documented fallback; then date-valid CRSP country metadata when available; finally CRSP USIncFlg to USA or UNKNOWN_FOREIGN; else UNKNOWN_COUNTRY

feature_sets.reduced_auxiliary_core: CRSP price/trend/risk/liquidity, availability-lagged Compustat fundamentals, stable identity categories, and common factor/market state; excludes OptionMetrics, 13F, SEC events, restatements, segments, and Pastor-Stambaugh.
feature_sets.market_price_liquidity_core: CRSP price/trend/risk/liquidity, stable identity categories, and common factor/market state only; excludes Compustat and every late or revised auxiliary family. This is distinct from reduced_auxiliary_core.
